description: Prove that a file or message existed at this time without revealing it: its sha256 gets a signed receipt with a position in a public log anchored daily on Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Software Heritage. Free signed sample: /x402/timestamp/sample. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Call without payment to get the requirements (isError result, 402 object in structuredContent); retry with the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']. Result is signed by neo and logged.
name: paid_timestamp
title: Paid: timestamp a sha256 (0.01 USDC)
